description:
MuleSoft Integration Developer 
 
 The MuleSoft Integration Developer designs, develops, tests, deploys, and supports enterprise integration solutions. This role builds and maintains B2B and B2C integrations, API-based services, and production workflows that connect ERP platforms and other business applications. The developer partners with product owners, architects, application teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

 Job Duties 

 Collaborate with product owners, architects, business teams, and application teams to understand functional and technical requirements.   
 Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain reusable MuleSoft APIs, integrations, and application components.     
 Develop new B2B and B2C integrations and enhance existing production integrations.    
 Monitor integration workflows, transactions, service-level alerts, logs, and production performance.  
 Investigate incidents, identify defects and bottlenecks, and implement durable corrective solutions.  
 Create and maintain technical documentation, including requirements, interface designs, data mappings, support procedures, and change records.   
 Apply coding, testing, security, logging, error-handling, and performance standards throughout the software development lifecycle.    
 Participate in Agile and DevOps delivery practices, including estimation, planning, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD.·     Respond to production-support requests from internal and external stakeholders and communicate status clearly.
 
 Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.·     
 Five or more years of professional information technology experience, including at least two years of API integration development.·     
 At least two years of hands-on development experience with MuleSoft 4 and Anypoint Studio.·     
 Hands-on experience with MuleSoft Runtime Fabric and working knowledge of CloudHub or hybrid deployment models.·     
 Experience designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services and API specifications using RAML or Swagger / OpenAPI.     
 Experience with DataWeave, JSON, XML, HTTP, MQ, SFTP, Maven, and secure data-exchange patterns.   
 Experience with Mule components such as+ transactions, asynchronous flows, message filters, and content enrichment.·     Experience with API Manager, Runtime Manager, MUnit, and integration testing tools such as JMeter.   
 Experience with CI/CD and source-management tools such as Jenkins, Maven, Nexus, Artifactory, and Git.     
 Working knowledge of Java, J2EE concepts, relational databases, and SQL queries.  
 Working knowledge of Linux commands, troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, logging, monitoring, and alerting.    
 Experience working as part of an Agile and/or DevOps team.
 
 Security & Integration Knowledge 

 API security standards and implementation patterns, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JSON Web Token (JWT), and X.509 certificates.
 Authentication, authorization, encryption, IP security configuration, endpoint configuration, and secure integration practices.·     
 API-led connectivity and the design of system, process, and experience API layers.·     
 Integration design patterns for routing, transformation, orchestration, error handling, logging, testing, and service resiliency. Logging, monitoring, and alerting platforms such as Splunk, OpsCenter, or SCOM
 
 Core Competencies 

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and collaborate effectively across teams.
 Ability to manage competing priorities, establish realistic expectations, and meet delivery commitments.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical and nontechnical audiences.
 Commitment to continuous learning, code quality, operational reliability, and secure engineering practices.
 
 Travel Requirements 

 Occasional travel to off-site business meetings or conferences. (5% proficiency)
 
 #LI – MD-1 
 
 
 The starting pay range for this position is:
 
$109,500.00 - $146,200.00 Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance.
 .
